verdict.rationale: Figma Make's evidence has no documented OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and a community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, forcing reverse-engineering. Publishing an API spec is a fair axis for a hosted app-building platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
